pages.title: Any Volunteers?
pages.text: Hire a real recruit through its native screen and supply food and a shield.

pages.title: Any Volunteers?
pages.text: A spare shield and ready sandwiches support provisioning the squad without granting a free new soldier.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find an available recruit and pay its displayed quote. Native payment or an authorized server replacement is determined by the current trading owner. Villager Workers are not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Spend emeralds to hire recruit villagers through the native interaction. The recruited units form a player-owned force.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Equip and provision recruited villagers with supported supplies. Native combat AI can eat, heal and block attacks.
